items.title: Is Micron (MU) Quietly Recasting Its AI Memory Strategy With New Leadership and 512GB DDR5?

By pairing a veteran ecosystem builder to lead long-horizon research with a record-capacity DDR5 module, Micron is tying its innovation agenda directly to future AI and data-center memory requirements...
